oracle_origin: Independent literal original product/AT requirements and frozen contract; baseline code only bounds existing semantics, never supplies generated expected answers.

oracles.title: Strict bounded reference-only JSON
oracles.stimulus: Supply exact existing owner/reviewer/domain/catalog references and a bounded reason; alternatively unknown or repeated keys at any nested level, extra capability lists, credential/hash/DSN/path/SQL fields, malformed types including boolean-as-version, or oversized input.
oracles.expect: Only the finite reference config is accepted. Invalid config is rejected before business writes and cannot create entities, choose arbitrary SQL/permissions or expose raw input/credentials in errors. Reason is bound by the plan hash and never echoed as free text.

oracles.title: Default is an actual read-only dry-run
oracles.stimulus: Run prepare-access --config FILE without --apply, including missing/blocked/no-change target states.
oracles.expect: Use a genuine READ ONLY transaction and only inspect current state/differences. Zero INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL, authorization_audit writes, session issuance, schema install or startup repair. Do not use FOR SHARE/FOR UPDATE row locking in this path. No transaction or missing permission exception implies approval.

oracles.title: Only existing exact current subjects and capabilities
oracles.stimulus: Use active same-domain enterprise_operator owner and park_specialist reviewer with pre-existing owner READ/EXECUTE and reviewer READ; then omit/deactivate/change role/domain/capability.
oracles.expect: Only the exact current prerequisites pass; all missing or mismatched rows block. No principal, capability/action/resource/Run grant, token, directory or material is created or reactivated. Existing role and scope checks are reused.

oracles.title: The original preparation-grant key determines missingness
oracles.stimulus: For each target principal/capability, supply no row, active same-scope row, inactive row, or same primary key with wrong park/org.
oracles.expect: Only truly absent original keys are insert candidates: owner PREPARE and reviewer REVIEW_ASSIGNED. Active same-scope rows are preserved. Inactive or wrong-scope same-key rows block the entire apply; no UPDATE, ON CONFLICT repair, deletion or resurrection. One existing valid row means at most the other missing row is inserted.

oracles.title: Existing catalogue proof is consumed, never published
oracles.stimulus: Reference the exact original supported service/version/park, namespace SYNTHETIC and qualification NOT_EVALUATED, with original publication proof and binding_catalog_known; try unknown/withdrawn/corrupt/changed/wrong-version source.
oracles.expect: Reuse the original proof and known-source rules. A valid original explicit SYNTHETIC catalogue without a journal remains supported when the original proof returns None; no forced INIT/PUBLISH or new source is invented. All bad or missing current references block and no catalogue field/history is modified.

oracles.title: Grant scope is represented truthfully
oracles.stimulus: Inspect planned/applied scope and use original owner/reviewer business endpoints afterward.
oracles.expect: The two grants have original principal+park/org+capability scope, not a single catalogue/Case restriction. Original owner-only and responsible-reviewer Case checks remain current on every request; config catalogue reference is a source fence, not a substitute narrowing or broadening of business authorization.

oracles.title: Apply needs both explicit fence intent and actual owner authority
oracles.stimulus: Request --apply with correct expected-plan SHA from a real direct database owner; alternatively omit/malform SHA, use the normal app role, merely grant INSERT, SET ROLE, or claim admin in config.
oracles.expect: Only explicit apply plus the exact current fence and actual session_user=current_user=database owner with ownership of relevant original public tables can write. A SHA, role flag, INSERT privilege, superuser label without the selected owner identity, or config text is not authorization. Normal app denial remains even if INSERT is accidentally available.

oracles.title: Management context is separate from runtime providers
oracles.stimulus: Use an existing application/provider-bound Store or mixed Native/isolated/ordinary service context instead of a fresh direct owner Store.
oracles.expect: Reject the mixed context; no fallback from a Native/default refusal, fixture permit or application actor to administrator rights. Runtime configured_app/worker do not auto-discover/call this command. No roles/schema/conftest changes or real installation are required or executed.

oracles.title: Plan SHA is a current-state fence, not approval
oracles.stimulus: Dry-run the same semantic config on the same actual endpoint/database/state, then change config/reason, database endpoint/OID/name/postmaster-start, relevant principal/capability/preparation-grant xmin or catalogue content/generation.
oracles.expect: A matching fence binds the normalized config and selected current state; each relevant change invalidates the old SHA. Credentials/token hashes/material bodies/DSN strings are not exposed or included as credentials in the plan. Actual endpoint+database OID/name+postmaster start is a bounded state fence, not a cryptographic instance identifier, signature, Approval or Native permit; no pg_control_system/root/seal privilege is added.

oracles.title: Apply acquires original locks before its final fresh decision
oracles.stimulus: Apply while another owned transaction holds a relevant principal/row/catalogue lock, then alter the relevant state before releasing the wait.
oracles.expect: Take original principal exclusive advisory locks in stable ID order, acquire required row/catalogue locks in deterministic order, and re-read all required generations/source/owner state after every admission wait before comparing the expected SHA and writing. Never compare a pre-wait cached plan as the final fence.

oracles.title: ABA and conflicting administration are rejected atomically
oracles.stimulus: Revoke/restore or replace a relevant row between dry-run and apply; concurrently attempt the same missing keys or introduce an inactive/wrong-scope key.
oracles.expect: Changed xmin/current state makes the old SHA stale, or an original uniqueness/lock conflict cleanly rejects/rolls back. No partial grant/audit set, ignored conflict or automatic retry that silently accepts the new state. Trusted-admin uncooperative rewriting/deleted historical revocations are not claimed detectable.

oracles.title: Original audit and both inserts share one transaction
oracles.stimulus: Apply a valid two-missing-grant plan; fail the second insert or original audit, or inspect the audit record.
oracles.expect: All required grant inserts and original authorization_audit records commit together or all roll back. Audit uses actual beneficiary principal, operation/specific capability/plan SHA and ALLOWED; it does not invent an application-admin identity or log reason/config/secrets. No new audit schema or alternate authorization engine.

oracles.title: NO_CHANGE and old-plan reuse are not false issuance or recovery
oracles.stimulus: After a successful apply, repeat the previous expected SHA, then take a new dry-run of the already active same-scope grants.
oracles.expect: The pre-insert SHA is stale after new xmin generations. A current no-difference plan returns NO_CHANGE without claiming a new grant. No persistent original-key receipt is invented, no automatic exact-request idempotency or cold-recovery guarantee is claimed, and existing valid grants remain byte-identical.

oracles.title: Commit connection failure leaves an unknown outcome
oracles.stimulus: Lose the client/connection around transaction commit or receive an ambiguous transport error.
oracles.expect: Report that the result is unconfirmed, never assert no commit solely from a connection exception, and never automatically replay apply. A new read-only dry-run can inspect current state; it is not an immutable receipt proving which original invocation committed. Errors do not echo credentials or raw config.

oracles.title: Applied prerequisites feed the original user flow
oracles.stimulus: In an explicitly owned synthetic test initial state containing existing legal subjects/capabilities/catalogue, add only the two missing preparation grants, then use original preparation HTTP entry/material REVIEW/CONFIRM and cold startup.
oracles.expect: Original current identity/Case/source algorithms consume the resulting grants; ordinary startup still does not seed or install. Principals/capabilities/catalogue/Run access/Native/provider/receipt resources remain unchanged. This finite code path is not a real management execution or formal end-to-end AT35.

oracles.title: New grant generations never revive an old CaseStep marker
oracles.stimulus: In owned negative data only, delete/reinsert a previously bound preparation grant through the proposed missing-key workflow, or restore a row after an original marker was issued.
oracles.expect: Original CaseStep current-generation checks still reject the old marker. The initializer need not infer deleted revocation history, but must never reset or rewrite a marker, UUID, original deadline, actor generation, receipt or lifecycle to revive it. Broader real subjects/catalogue/executor/resource initialization and Windows/formal installation remain separate gaps.

parent_preimplementation_clarifications.decision: Fresh direct owner context; actual database owner=session_user=current_user and relevant original public table owners; reject runtime/provider-bound Store. No new fixture authority.
Genuine READ ONLY and no row locks/audit. Preserve valid original no-journal SYNTHETIC catalogue. Audit principal is beneficiary, not invented application administrator.

Actual connection endpoint hashed internally, database OID/name and pg_postmaster_start_time. No pg_control_system, OS seal/root or new privilege. State fence only, no cryptographic identity or physical commit-time guarantee.

Frozen V1 product line317 is section9.3; plan line325 is section11 and line366 section13. Contract line anchors and actual source text are used rather than the mistaken chapter numbers. A later mechanical citation correction may be recorded as a frozen diff; this oracle is not overwritten.

bounded_future_groups.design: Strict nested duplicate/unknown/credential-shaped config plus genuine read-only dry-run and complete business/authorization/audit snapshot.
Small current-state matrix: missing/active/inactive/wrong-scope keys; exact original no-journal and invalid catalogue; no entity import/publication.
Actual owned owner versus original app connection and a mixed provider; exact database/fence changes; never grant the app INSERT merely to bypass a guard.
Real owned PG lock wait with relevant generation change; exact stale rejection and original two-insert/audit rollback, using no new schema/roles.
Success/old SHA/current NO_CHANGE and a narrowly instrumented commit-uncertainty path with no auto-replay; preserve precise actual outcome versus unknown.
One original preparation user/cold-read chain from existing synthetic principals and current capabilities, plus old-marker generation refusal; no old P5 matrix.

limits: No WIP implementation read or sign-off. Wait for final SHA before owned PG/tests.
Only private runtime writes; root sole tracked/Git writer.
No roles/schema/conftest mutation, real browser/Windows/model/root/seal retry.
No old P5 42-node whole-slice rerun or transferred counts.
